say.description: What the wizard says aloud. Required, never empty.

caption.description: On-screen text, if it should differ from say.

action.description: One animation name: hello, magic, teach, listening, thinking, correct, correct_alt, try_again, try_again_alt, one_hand, groan, call_back, fading, worried, charge, celebrate, laugh

report.description: ONLY on the report turn. Omit it on every other turn.
